WHERE IT’S FROM
Affalterbach, Germany, is an orchard town where trophies are
harvested. It’s the home of AMG, where for nearly 50 years,
championship racecars have been created by a team of people
who are not just racers. They’re dreamers. Visionaries. And
perfectionists. They develop technologies that heighten power,
like patented NANOSLIDE® cylinder walls that slash friction and
wear. They shatter limitations: Rear‑biased AMG Performance
4matic® clings to pavement yet delivers nimble balance. They
break Formula 1® records, and are by far the most winning name
in the DTM (German Touring Car Championship). And they turn
victory on the track into vehicles that conquer the streets of
the world — and the hearts of its most passionate drivers.
IS WHAT IT DOES
Each of the three AMG C‑Class sedans is infused with the
DNA of racing champions and the hardware to bring it to life:
massive brakes, AMG RIDE CONTROL with 3‑stage damping,
1 8" or 19" AMG® wheels,2 aero‑aggressive bodywork, and a
driver‑focused cockpit. In the AMG C 43, a 362‑hp biturbo V6
and paddle‑shifted 9‑speed team with AMG Performance 4matic
for a 4.6‑second rush to 60 mph.9 A diamond‑block grille and
distinctive styling conceal an exclusive front axle. Handcrafted
biturbo V8s thrust the 469‑hp AMG C 63 and 503‑hp C 63 S to
class‑leading power and torque, and 0‑60 mph in as little as
3.9 seconds. Bespoke details identify each C 63, along with an
“A‑wing” front air dam, a power‑dome hood, and unique front
fenders — necessary to clear their 1.1"‑wider front axle. AMG
Performance options on all three sedans include racing‑style
front seats and a symphonic multimode active exhaust system.

DYNAMIC SELECT
A M O D E F O R
E V E R Y M O O D
All roads are not created the same. Nor all days, or — most importantly — all drivers. With
DYNAMIC SELECT, the flip of a console paddle engages any of five performance profiles for the
throttle response, shi(cid:29)ing and handling feel. You can even customize a mode of your own.
Some sedans are sporty. Some are refined. Some are
efficient. One of the most compelling reasons to drive a
C-Class Sedan is the way it does all of these, satisfying
your cravings, wishes and needs by keeping them all in
balance, not by sacrificing one in favor of another.
Likewise, there are smooth roads. Curvy roads. Slippery
roads. And there are times you just want to make the
same road you drive every day feel different — cavorting
with its corners on a Saturday, coddling your family on
a Sunday, and conserving fuel on your daily commute.
DYNAMIC SELECT lets you tune the driving character
of your C-Class to all of these factors at the flip of a
switch. Five programs — from Comfort to Sport+ to an
à la carte Individual mode you can set up to your liking —
adapt the throttle response, shift points, steering feel,
ECO Start/Stop,* and AIRMATIC® air suspension.*
AMG DYNAMIC SELECT on the three Mercedes-AMG
sedans lets you further dial in the shifting, adaptive
damping, exhaust sound and more — plus a RACE mode
in the C 63 S. Adjacent pushbuttons offer direct access
to the suspension settings and Manual shift mode.

C-Class Sedan is the way it does all of these, satisfying
your cravings, wishes and needs by keeping them all in
balance, not by sacrificing one in favor of another.
Likewise, there are smooth roads. Curvy roads. Slippery
roads. And there are times you just want to make the
same road you drive every day feel different — cavorting
with its corners on a Saturday, coddling your family on
a Sunday, and conserving fuel on your daily commute.
DYNAMIC SELECT lets you tune the driving character
of your C-Class to all of these factors at the flip of a
switch. Five programs — from Comfort to Sport+ to an
à la carte Individual mode you can set up to your liking —
adapt the throttle response, shift points, steering feel,
ECO Start/Stop,* and AIRMATIC® air suspension.*
AMG DYNAMIC SELECT on the three Mercedes-AMG
sedans lets you further dial in the shifting, adaptive
damping, exhaust sound and more — plus a RACE mode
in the C 63 S. Adjacent pushbuttons offer direct access
to the suspension settings and Manual shift mode.
